title: Conceptual overview: the living review pipeline
text: create_metawoRld() creates folder (default Git repository): Studies stored DOI PMID (normalized, encoded file system sanitize_id()), cached screening/extraction results stored data always refer paper.
code: my_review/ ├── _metawoRld.yml           # name, description, inclusion/exclusion criteria ├── _extraction_schema.yml   # what is extracted from each study ├── _assessment_schema.yml   # what a screening decision looks like ├── _extraction_prompt.txt   # LLM instructions (used by DataFindR) ├── _assessment_prompt.txt ├── data/ │   └── <study id>/ │       ├── metadata.yml     # design, population, methods, groups │       └── data.csv         # one row per reported statistic ├── .metawoRld_cache/        # DataFindR's cached LLM results (shareable) └── index.qmd, studies.qmd, data.qmd, _quarto.yml, ...   # website

title: Conceptual overview: the living review pipeline
text: templates generic: studies methods groups, every reported statistic data point method_id, group_id, variable_name, timepoint, sample_size, statistic_type three values. Edit _extraction_schema.yml fit review: add fields, tighten descriptions, turn free-text fields enums. schema node looks like : _ref links checked validate_links() used load_metawoRld() join, example, group_name method_unit onto data.
code: group_id:   _type: string                 # object, array, string, integer, number, boolean, enum   _description: "Shown to the LLM."   _required: true               # default   _ref: groups.group_id         # must match an id in metadata$groups

title: Conceptual overview: the living review pipeline
text: Set project create_metawoRld() adjust schema criteria. Identify records: DataFindR::df_search_pubmed() (repeat pick new publications), df_fetch_metadata() / df_add_metadata(). Screen titles abstracts: DataFindR::df_assess_batch() parallel discounted batch APIs; review override df_shiny_assess(). Extract data full texts included studies: DataFindR::df_extract_batch(); check correct df_shiny_extract(). Import: DataFindR::df_import_batch() validates study add_study_data() stores . Check validate_world(), follow progress DataFindR::df_status() df_prisma_counts(). Publish generate_website(); use_github_action_quarto() makes GitHub rebuild site every push. Analyse load_metawoRld(). Every LLM result cached project together model, token use, cost fingerprint prompt, schema criteria. Re-running step processes new studies studies whose results produced outdated setup. Manual decisions corrections never overwritten.

title: Getting started
code: library(DataFindR) Sys.setenv(DATAFINDR_EMAIL = "you@example.org")   # polite use of NCBI/Crossref  # 1. Records hits <- df_search_pubmed(   '("Infant, Newborn"[Mesh] OR neonat*) AND Doppler AND (cerebral OR brain)',   path )  # 2. Screening (parallel; use mode = "batch" for half price with OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) chat_screen <- ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4.1-mini") screen <- df_assess_batch(chat_screen, hits$identifier, path) df_shiny_assess(path, chat_screen)          # review "Needs manual review"  # 3. Extraction from full texts saved as fulltext/<df_fulltext_filename(id)> df_pending_extraction(path) chat_extract <- ellmer::chat_anthropic() df_extract_batch(chat_extract, file.path(path, "fulltext"), path) df_shiny_extract(path, chat_extract, fulltext_dir = file.path(path, "fulltext"))  # 4. Import and check df_import_batch(metawoRld_path = path) df_status(path) df_prisma_counts(path)
